recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-28096 unless a future work group decision changes the specimen semantics rather than the cardinality already applied here.
issue_request: FHIR-28096 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for R5 asking to change ObservationDefinition.specimen from 0..1 to 0..* Reference(SpecimenDefinition). The accepted resolution kept the minimum at 0 and recorded that multiple specimen references mean logical AND: all listed specimen kinds are needed.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in commit 56b91f72c1e36104fa43f12c189891648867d5bd, which changed ObservationDefinition.specimen max from 1 to * and expanded the comment to include the multiple-specimens AND semantics. Later refactoring, including commit 49b86f8a6978650d8f8a6d36d27dee0433e455bc, preserved the applied source state.
additional_context: ObservationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/observationdefinition/structuredefinition-ObservationDefinition.xml is in current build scope. OO Confluence minutes for 2020-12-17 record the same current/requested cardinality and AND wording in the Catalog block vote accepted 13-0-4. Direct FHIR-28096 Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current authoritative XML already has min 0, max *, targetProfile SpecimenDefinition, and the AND comment, and current-source search found no stale ObservationDefinition specimen 0..1 residue.
